parent.previous_P51_POL_result: 0/3 strong advantage; D-opt and orthogonal exact same action decisions

question: Can a token-free two-stage factual-reward trained policy learn when a costly diagnostic action is worth executing, improving net eventual decision reward on unfamiliar signal and cost ranges beyond equally trained conventional recurrent control, wrong-reward-credit training, always/never probe and an explicit model-aware Bayesian benchmark?

source.source_kind: new developer-authored stochastic physical analogue; NOT independent scientific source first-use
source.latent_effect: theta equiprobable +1/-1; hidden from both policies
source.cue_physical_law: cue = theta*cue_gain + Normal(0,cue_sigma), generated before any action
source.probe_physical_law: only if executing paid diagnostic +1: measurement=theta*probe_gain + Normal(0,probe_sigma); never provide measurement when not probed
source.final_physical_action: choose signed +/-1; actual observed exploitation reward = theta*chosen_signed_action; total net reward subtracts paid diagnostic cost if executed
source.shared_source_fairness: same theta/cue/context and precommitted independent probe-noise tape for all policy arms; each arm chooses its own actual probe and exploit actions; never train on unexecuted alternative consequences

methods.candidate: Trainable 2-head factorized MLP, probe yes/no head on six factual initial observations; second head on those six plus actual probe indicator and actual probe measurement. Both heads learn from only real physical net return via on-policy REINFORCE. No privileged theta or Bayesian logodds engineered features.
methods.trained_conventional: GRUCell recurrent policy sees same six factual initial observations and second 6-dimensional factual observation (cue, actual probe flag, paid probe measurement, probe_gain, probe_sigma, cost); two output heads; parameter-count match within 10%
methods.wrong_credit: Exact candidate architecture initialized identically per model seed, but REINFORCE physical net reward is rolled one batch position for gradient credit (real actions/rewards remain intact).
methods.conventional_Bayesian: strong model-aware analytical baseline uses specified public noise law and observed signal parameters for posterior; calculates exact normal-distribution value of probe via known generative model; not an unprivileged learned baseline, report as Bayes model-aware ceiling
methods.always_probe: every world physically probes, then uses model-aware factual posterior exploitation decision
methods.never_probe: never probes, exploits from model-aware factual cue posterior
methods.simple_confidence: probe if abs(cue)/cue_sigma <0.5 and cost<0.25, exploit from model-aware factual posterior
methods.random: random probe and random exploit with precommitted RNG; report same source actions/costs

training.update_target: REINFORCE score gradients for sampled probe and actual exploit actions * (physically observed net return minus common detached running baseline); wrong-credit rolls the return over episode batch before computing policy gradient
training.baseline_convergence: last two val net reward checkpoints differ <=.02; otherwise trained convergence UNVERIFIED
training.cold_restore: fresh identical architecture + loaded weights returns exactly same deterministic preview logits and decisions

thresholds.per_seed_ood_net_reward: candidate >= conventional_gru +.02 AND candidate >= max(always_probe,never_probe,simple_confidence)+.02, every one of 3 model seeds
thresholds.bayes_proximity: Bayesian aware ceiling minus candidate OOD reward <=.05 in every seed; cannot claim exceed analytic oracle
thresholds.wrong_credit_margin: candidate OOD net reward >= wrong_credit+.05 every seed
thresholds.cost_sensitivity: among weak cues with strong probe gain, low-cost (<.20) probe fraction exceeds high-cost (>=.40) probe fraction by >=.20 every seed
thresholds.no_opportunity_leakage: model never receives probe measurement when it did not physically probe; physically observed reward only after signed exploit
thresholds.retained_pretraining: validation fixed policy performance without changes during separate OOD evaluation; no per-episode test updates
thresholds.strong_training: all neural last-two validation net rewards within .02, else CONVERGENCE_UNVERIFIED
thresholds.positive_scientific_pass: IMPOSSIBLE_FROM_AUTHOR_GENERATED_DEV; needs new independently owner-qualified source, genuine physical unfamiliar dynamics, cost/compute parity, stronger model-aware controls and full platform regression

limitations.full_FLOP_total_training_cost: report wall times, exact parity not assumed
